name: DIRECT ANGIO
fullName: Direct versus Conventional Transfer to Angiography Suite in Patients with Severe Acute Stroke Treated with Thrombectomy (France)
teachingPoint: Bypassing pre-EVT imaging increased sICH without benefit and was halted early — cautions against direct-to-angio in suspected LVO.

name: EVA-TRISP prior-APT analysis
fullName: Previous Antiplatelet Therapy and Outcomes of Acute Ischemic Stroke With Large Vessel Occlusion Treated With Direct Endovascular Therapy (EVA-TRISP registry)
population: n=1308, Mean 75.8 ± 11.4, NIHSS Mean NIHSS 13.1 ± 7.2, Consecutive patients 2015-2023; no interaction with time-to-groin earlier/later than 6 h (p=0.743)
finding: Any previous APT associated with a shift toward LOWER mRS: OR 1.30; 90-day independence OR 1.62 (95% CI 1.22-2.16, p=0.001)
teachingPoint: In direct EVT for anterior-circulation LVO, prior antiplatelet therapy was associated with better 90-day outcomes and no excess sICH — prior APT is a reason for reassurance, never a reason to withhold or delay thrombectomy.
